description: A collapsed fire shrine still warm with old qi.
text: Embers glow in the cracked altar. A warmth presses against your meridians, asking a question.

You find an old offering box.

name: The Frost Hermit's Trial
description: An old hermit of ice offers a test of the blade.
text: The hermit does not look up. 'Cut the falling leaf without touching the frost on it.'

outcomes.text: The leaf parts; the frost holds. Metal and Water awaken in you.
The frost shatters. He sighs and feeds you.
He nods once. The clearing is quiet.

name: Whisper in the Reeds
description: Someone is singing in the reeds. Something is listening.

choices.text: Plug your ears and back away.

outcomes.text: The song fades. You keep your wits.
